scenarios.name: interceptors and request lifecycle
scenarios.config:
config-version: 8
host: 127.0.0.1
port: PORT
auth-dir: AUTHDIR
remote-management:
  disable-control-panel: true
api-keys:
  - "k1"
plugins:
  enabled: true
  dir: PLUGINDIR
  configs:
    ic:
      enabled: true
      record: RECDIR
      label: ic
      caps: request_interceptor,response_interceptor,response_stream_interceptor,request_lifecycle_plugin
      priority: 3
    rt:
      enabled: true
      record: RECDIR
      label: rt
      caps: model_router,executor
      priority: 2
openai-compatibility:
  - name: up
    base-url: UPSTREAM/v1
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: fake-up
    models:
      - name: up-model
        alias: up-alias
  - name: down
    base-url: UPSTREAM/down
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: fake-down
    models:
      - name: down-model
        alias: down-alias
  - name: sse
    base-url: UPSTREAM/sse
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: fake-sse
    models:
      - name: sse-model
        alias: sse-alias

headers.Access-Control-Expose-Headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

scenarios.name: interceptors with passthrough headers
scenarios.config:
config-version: 8
host: 127.0.0.1
port: PORT
auth-dir: AUTHDIR
remote-management:
  disable-control-panel: true
api-keys:
  - "k1"
plugins:
  enabled: true
  dir: PLUGINDIR
  configs:
    ic:
      enabled: true
      record: RECDIR
      label: ic
      caps: response_interceptor,response_stream_interceptor
requests:
  passthrough-headers: true
openai-compatibility:
  - name: up
    base-url: UPSTREAM/v1
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: fake-up
    models:
      - name: up-model
        alias: up-alias
  - name: sse
    base-url: UPSTREAM/sse
    api-key-entries:
      - api-key: fake-sse
    models:
      - name: sse-model
        alias: sse-alias

config-version: 8
host: 127.0.0.1
port: PORT
auth-dir: AUTHDIR
remote-management:
  disable-control-panel: true
api-keys:
  - "k1"
plugins:
  enabled: true
  dir: PLUGINDIR
  configs:
    ic:
      enabled: true
      record: RECDIR
      label: ic
      caps: response_stream_interceptor,request_lifecycle_plugin

  streaming:

openai-compatibility:
